title: My House
description: My House is a single-level Doom II mod set in a suburban home that rapidly unfolds into a surreal, multi-layered experience. While advertised as a short ten-minute map, it features hours of hidden content, including mirror dimensions, collectible artifacts, and sprawling alternate environments such as a daycare, bathhouse, and airport.

notes: Requires GZDoom/UZDoom with hardware renderer. April 2025 author's update — works on GZDoom 4.8.1 and newer, adds a few new areas.
